item.title: COMPASS Center Based Elementary
item.description:
Youth and Community Development | Procurement | Award | $6.5M | Vendor: Bronx House Inc. In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Bronx House Inc. a $6,466,905 contract for COMPASS Center Based Elementary after-school, summer and holiday programs for elementary students, selected from competing proposals drawn from a pre-qualified list.

COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.

item.title: Speciation & drug resistance testing for all samples
item.description:
Health and Mental Hygiene | Procurement | Award | $73K | Vendor: Health Research Inc In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded Health Research Inc a $73,071 sole source contract, without competitive bidding, for tuberculosis drug resistance and molecular testing performed through the state Department of Health's Wadsworth Center.

Health Research Incorporated (HRI), who is designated as a research institute and membership corporation affiliated with the NYS Department of Health (NYS DOH), will provide DOHMH with support, supplement or extend the functions and programs of NYS DOH, for speciation & drug resistance testing. Under this sole source contract, the NYS DOH Wadsworth Center, Mycobacteriology Laboratory will perform Tuberculosis (TB) molecular testing services, including deletion analysis, targeted next generation sequencing (tNGS), and whole genome sequencing (WGS) to perform to ensure rapid, accurate, and comprehensive TB diagnostic and genotyping capacity.
